summary: Tested 3 fixes: (1) MRP Sales Orders column only shows SOs contributing to shortage, (2) Child MO creation uses shortage qty (required - stock), (3) Without Material SC orders show 'Create PO' button instead of 'Send DC'. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified all 3 fixes working correctly.
passed_tests: MRP demand returns only items with net_requirement > 0
MRP demand orders are shortage-contributing SOs only
MRP demand only returns raw_material category items
Child MO uses shortage qty logic (required - stock)
Work orders endpoint returns data including child MOs
Without material SC orders exist in system
Create PO rejects duplicate (JW-000020 already has PO-000019)
Without material orders have subcontract_type field for 'No RM' badge
With material orders have correct subcontract_type
Without material receive logic uses quantity not sent_quantity
PO has reference_sc_order_id linking to SC order
Frontend: JW-000020 shows 'No RM' badge + 'Create PO' button (no 'Send DC')
Frontend: JW-000018 shows 'No RM' badge + 'Create PO' button (no 'Send DC')
Frontend: MRP page shows 'Outstanding Sales Orders' dropdown
Frontend: MRP demand table shows only 2 items with net_requirement > 0
Frontend: RM-002 shows SOs: SO-000005, SO-000006, PO-000001
seed_data_creation: Created PO-000020 for JW-000018 during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3 fixes verified working: (1) MRP Sales Orders column filters to only show SOs that contribute to shortage - implemented in server.py lines 1325-1341 using running_available logic. (2) Child MO creation uses shortage_qty = child_qty - current_stock (server.py lines 2889-2895). (3) Without Material SC orders show 'Create PO' button (brown color) instead of 'Send DC' - implemented in JobWorkPage.js lines 352-357 with condition o.subcontract_type !== 'without_material' for Send DC and o.subcontract_type === 'without_material' for Create PO.

mrp_so_filtering.details: MRP demand only shows SOs that contribute to shortage. Uses running_available logic to filter out SOs covered by stock. RM-002 shows SO-000005, SO-000006, PO-000001. RM-001 shows PO-000001.

child_mo_shortage_qty.details: Child MO creation uses shortage_qty = child_qty - current_stock. If stock >= required, child MO is skipped entirely (server.py lines 2883-2895)

without_material_create_po.details: Without Material SC orders (JW-000020, JW-000018) show 'Create PO' button (brown) instead of 'Send DC'. 'No RM' badge displayed. POST /api/job-work/create-po creates PO with reference_sc_order_id. Duplicate PO creation rejected.

without_material_receive.details: Without Material SC orders show 'Receive' button. Pending qty calculated as quantity - received_quantity (not sent_quantity since nothing is sent for without_material orders)
